sources.title: DeiT · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Usage tips Compared to ViT, DeiT models use a so-called distillation token to effectively learn from a teacher (which, in the DeiT paper, is a ResNet like-model). The distillation token is learned through backpropagation, by interacting with the class ( [CLS]) and patch tokens through the self-attention layers.
